int_name: N BROAD ST & W ROCKLAND ST

result.summary: The intersection features a wide multi-lane roadway with high-visibility crosswalk markings and a bus stop. While sidewalks and traffic signals are present, the lack of a median refuge and the long crossing distance increase pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway across the marked crosswalk

hazards.name: Visual obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb may obstruct sight lines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb line

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sight lines.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with commercial and residential land use. While sidewalks and traffic signals are present, the lack of marked crosswalks and significant crossing distances create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this multi-leg intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.

hazards.name: Large Vehicle Obstruction
hazards.description: Large vehicles (SUV and pickup truck) in the intersection and parked near corners block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic without a refuge island.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at corners to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane commercial corridor with high-visibility zebra crosswalks and overhead traffic signals. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like sidewalks and marked crossings are present, the lack of a median refuge and the long crossing distance across four or more lanes create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic plus parking areas without a median refuge, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the right side may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway near the crosswalk

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light, increasing their visibility in the crosswalk.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including a high-visibility continental crosswalk and sidewalks in good condition. However, the environment lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and contains visual obstructions from parked vehicles that may compromise safety at the crossing.

hazards.name: Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked along the side street can block the view between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The absence of visible pedestrian signal heads at a signalized intersection increases the risk of crossing against traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information.
